verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state connectors handle incremental syncs automatically with no pipelines to maintain, and detail sync modes (soft delete, live, history), delete capture, and re-sync options at table/connection level, indicating cursor/state management is fully automated. One HN report mentions an occasional full re-sync needed due to sync drift, but this is an edge-case exception rather than contradicting the core incremental-sync claim. Missing for 10: independent technical verification of cursor mechanics/state storage and more detail on how state is exposed/recovered on failure.
